verdict.rationale: Okta is a developer-facing identity platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis. However, the evidence pack never documents any official SDKs or client libraries. The material instead covers SSO and SCIM concepts, event hooks, an MCP server, and Cross App Access blog posts. The only adjacent mention is a community complaint about neglected 'open source packages' (okta-comm-9), which is too vague to establish that official SDKs exist.
